title: Me and a Memory
description: In “Me and a Memory” by Zainab H, an EmpowerHer student, the writer reflects on a childhood memory centered around her brother’s bicycle and a lasting scar on her forehead. Through vivid storytelling, she captures innocence, joy, pain, and the quiet influence of patriarchal expectations, showing how a small personal memory can hold deeper truths about family, protection, and silence.
